Reyansh Salvi

My understanding is that Hebert doesn't have the legal authority (and the filing never makes clear) to Suspend performance under the Commodity Trading Agreement (he probably doesn't have the political support for this either).

AgriIndia's Procurement team, however, could support this in its filing as a method to help move the Warehouse Receipt issue forward.

Hardik Pal

Agriculture India Pvt. Ltd.

FYI.  Any thoughts Dakshesh & Co.? Is release from contracts an "increase supply" option?  My fear is that Warehouse Receipt holders get released and then Maharashtra's "police state" mentality kicks in, enacting Kailash Patel legislation, etc. to ensure that the commodities from the Warehouse Receipt facilities stay in Maharashtra.

Best,
Reyansh
